scope: Static recovery of the supported auto-translate selection/send boundary and the adjacent control-bearing text parser. Map and World chat paths were investigated separately. The retained retail capture corpus is closed; no new retail-service evidence is expected.
verdict: The retained read-only exports recover a chat dispatch boundary, caller-supplied string/control paths, Map and World packet builders, and an independent control-bearing text parser. They do not recover the UI callback or editor write that creates a fixedPhrase, item, or place token, and they do not prove that the generic control parser is the auto-translate codec. The bounded parser observations below must not be used as a speculative auto-translate decoder.

facts: The dispatcher reads the submitted string object and branches on channel keys including group, shout, emote, and say.
The group branch obtains a 32-bit-sized value from FUN_006C0590 using the selected Group entry and passes it through FUN_0075C1A0 after FUN_006C9690 succeeds.
The static path does not identify that Group value as a fixedPhrase, item, or place token; the UI callback or editor write that creates a selection token remains untraced.
The three wrappers use context markers 1, 2, and 0x19 when their param_4 branch is zero and resolve the channel owner through FUN_004D9970.

Their alternate branch obtains this+0x7F8 through FUN_004D75A0 and passes it into FUN_00C99E40. The retained function listing shows that FUN_00C99E40 preserves ECX as parser context, obtains the source pointer from its first stack argument through FUN_00445210, restores ECX for FUN_00C99B80, and the parser reads context offsets +0x8, +0xC, and +0x2C.

The +0x7F8 value is therefore an unclassified parser/control-context pointer in this evidence; it is not proven to be an edit buffer. The wrappers do not contain a fixedPhrase table lookup or a token-byte write.
FUN_004D8160 accepts a normalized caller-supplied string/control object, checks the selected RelativeElement, and calls FUN_004E0320 after FUN_00C99E40 succeeds.

FUN_004E0320 zero-fills a local 0x200-byte area, copies the FUN_004451F0-derived source string length into it, then copies a fixed 0x200-byte destination field into the Map record and writes c2s opcode 0x0003 with record size 0x230 before FUN_00DAE010.

No phrase row key, category field, or fixedPhrase encoder write is visible in the exported Map builder copy boundary; optional FUN_004CE760 UI forwarding is not identified as an auto-translate producer.
Both World paths validate or normalize a caller-supplied string object through FUN_00C99E40 before packet construction.

FUN_004DF6D0 derives the source string length through FUN_004451F0, copies it into a local source area, then writes c2s opcode 0x00C9 with record size 0x218 and copies the fixed destination message field; the source object is not proven to be a 0x200-byte buffer.

FUN_004DF810 derives and copies source text into local source areas before delegating to FUN_004E3750, which copies a fixed source area into the destination message field and writes c2s opcode 0x00C8 with record size 0x230; the source object is not proven to be a 0x200-byte buffer.
Neither World builder reaches a fixedPhrase table lookup or a token-byte producer; optional UI forwarding remains outside this producer claim.
The FUN_004DAA10 -> FUN_004DA680 -> FUN_00447260(xtx/_fixedPhrase) -> FUN_00C9D550 table path has no edge to the selection dispatch, Map or World sender, or FUN_007906C0.
FUN_007906C0 is a generic render-control parser with no fixedPhrase lookup edge in the retained target set.
The observed fixedPhrase leading-byte branches and renderer control bytes are not established auto-translate wire tags.

controlParserContract.applicationStatus: A generic control-bearing text parser is recovered; its relationship to auto-translate selection tokens is unresolved.

framing.value: A control segment starts with 0x02, carries a selector byte and a length code, and a handled segment must be followed by 0x03. Plain runs are scanned until NUL or the next 0x02.

discriminator.value: 0x02 is the parser control discriminator; selector values 0x00 through 0x36 are admitted before the handler-table lookup.
discriminator.rejected: Selector values at or above 0x37 reject.

lengths.shortForm: Length codes 0x01 through 0xD7 consume one length byte and set payload length to code minus one.
lengths.extendedForm: Length codes 0xF0 through 0xFE delegate to FUN_00CB2020, which returns a type-specific consumed header width and decoded payload length.
lengths.inputBound: No explicit input-length argument is passed to FUN_00C99B80; truncated extended controls therefore remain unresolved.

widthOrder.value: The observed order is discriminator, selector, length code or extended length form, payload, and required 0x03 terminator for a handled control.
widthOrder.byteOrder: No single global byte order is established; FUN_00CB2020 contains type-specific shift/add forms.

escaping.value: No auto-translate escaping or literal-byte quoting rule is proven.

nulUtf8.value: NUL terminates the outer text walk. Plain runs are passed to FUN_00445C70 for UTF-8 validation; this does not establish locale or auto-translate Unicode semantics.

interleaving.value: The parser resumes after each handled segment and accepts plain runs between control candidates; selection-side literal/control interleaving is not proven.

unknownTruncated.value: Selectors at or above 0x37 and rejected length ranges reject. For an accepted-range selector with a handler, a handler failure or missing 0x03 rejects. An accepted-range selector with no handler rejects when the parser parameter is zero and, when that parameter is nonzero, skips directly to the next outer walk without checking 0x03. Truncated extended input behavior is unresolved because no input bound is provided.

facts: The fixedPhrase table path and generic FUN_007906C0 renderer were independently recovered but do not connect to the Map or World senders in the retained target set.
A received auto-translate control-to-row lookup and the choice between render and forwarding remain unresolved.

map_chain: FUN_006E91F0 branches on five string keys and reaches FUN_0075BEF0, FUN_0075BFD0, or FUN_0075C0B0.
The three wrappers call FUN_004D8160 at VAs 0x0075BFA0, 0x0075C080, and 0x0075C160 with context markers 1, 2, and 0x19.
FUN_004D8160 casts Application::Main::RaptureElement to Application::Main::Element::RelativeElement through FUN_009DA6CC, prepares caller-supplied state, and calls FUN_004E0320 at VA 0x004D8279.

FUN_004E0320 is the sole Map c2s 0x0003 emitter. It zero-fills a local 0x200-byte area, copies the FUN_004451F0-derived source string length into it, then copies a fixed 0x200-byte destination field into the record, writes opcode 0x0003 and record size 0x230, and sends through FUN_00DAE010.
No fixedPhrase lookup, table identity, phrase ID, or token-byte write is present in this chain.
world_chain: FUN_004DF6D0 builds World c2s 0x00C9 at size 0x218 and sends through FUN_00DB3E30.
FUN_004DF810 calls FUN_004E3750, which builds World c2s 0x00C8 at size 0x230 before FUN_00DB3E30.

Both World paths derive source string lengths through the generic string helpers and copy into fixed destination message fields; the source object is not proven to be a 0x200-byte buffer. Neither reaches FUN_004E0320 or a fixedPhrase lookup.

receiver_search.parser: FUN_007906C0 at VA 0x007906C0 is an 800-byte generic render-control byte-stream parser. Its direct callers are FUN_0089FBF0, FUN_0089EB40, FUN_0089E320, FUN_00790AA0, FUN_00790B20, FUN_00790A30, and FUN_00790BA0. The cases dispatch through a renderer interface, but no caller reaches a fixedPhrase table lookup.
receiver_search.fixed_phrase_path: The independent static table path is FUN_004DAA10 -> FUN_004DA680 -> FUN_00447260("xtx/_fixedPhrase", string VA 0x00F90D70) -> FUN_00C9D550. FUN_00C9D550 has null/state failure returns and branches on leading bytes 0x40 and 0x23, but no edge joins it to a Map or World chat sender, receiver, or FUN_007906C0. Those bytes are therefore not established wire tags.
receiver_search.other_negative: FUN_004D9D70 references the unrelated string "//shortcut %d <t>" at VA 0x00F90D84 and calls FUN_0056DD20. It has no fixedPhrase or chat-parser edge.

table_evidence.corpus: The authenticated xivl-client-data csv/xtx__fixedPhrase.csv has 758 data rows and SHA256 A9CE38B0B4CA33E1C03BF22BC854E054BB46DB1CEF9EDFB4E9C55C5D0516A16C. Its CSV row key is stored separately from field 0. Row 974 has field 0 value 9 and localized Map text; row 1255 has field 0 value 10 and localized /map text. Neither value is joined to wire bytes.

It does not prove that those row keys occur in a SendLog or chat wire field.

capture_evidence.retail_corpus: The owner-attested 1.23b retail corpus is fixed at 54 capture files. It contains two Map c2s 0x0003 messages with 576-byte sub-events in chat_say and chat_shout, and eleven World c2s 0x00C9 messages with 552-byte sub-events in party_battle_leve and war_quest_update2. The derived samples do not independently identify an auto-translate selection, CSV row, locale, or rendered phrase.
